name: Yukawa Ayano
source:
One of the three girls who bullied the protagonist's younger sister. She is the leader of the bullies. She is also a popular actress with her natural beauty and mysterious appearance. She has been studying theater since she was a child, and made her debut as an actress through numerous auditions. On the surface, she acts as a well-behaved and polite girl, but in her heart, she thinks that others exist only to enhance her and to use them.
